summary: Recent changes to the MP4 decoder in Firefox include the addition of default HDR (High Dynamic Range) metadata. **This is significant because it enhances the playback quality of videos encoded in HDR, providing a richer and more vibrant visual experience.** HDR technology is becoming increasingly common in video content, and by improving its support, Firefox is ensuring that users can fully enjoy modern video formats. This update reflects a commitment to keeping the browser up-to-date with industry standards, even if users may not see a direct _visual change_ immediately.
